entries: The tarrasque pup takes half damage from any {@spell magic missile} spell, line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The tarrasque pup deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Titanic Growth
entries: Over the course of an uninterrupted long rest, the tarrasque pup grows into a {@creature Tarrasque}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarrasque pup makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tarrasque pup can't bite another target.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Swallow
entries: If the tarrasque pup hits a bite attack against a small or tiny creature it is grappling, the target takes the bite's damage, is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attack and other effects outside the tarrasque pup, and it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque pup's turns.

If the tarrasque pup takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque pup must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque pup. If the tarrasque pup dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 ft. of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Lich's Familiar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Conduit of Malice
entries: As an action, a lich can look through the eyes of its familiar and see and hear what it hears until the end of the turn. The lich can also speak through the familiar, but cannot cast spells through it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The familiar makes two attacks; one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Deathly Yowl {@recharge 5}
entries: The familiar emits a bloodcurdling yowl. Each creature within 30 feet of the familiar that can hear the yowl becomes {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. In addition, they must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or drop to 1 hit point.

action.name: Fey Arrow
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit +5} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) radiant damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 9} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Unlucky Charm
entries: The Shroomsprite magically distracts a creature it can see within 60 ft. of it making an attack roll, ability check or saving throw. That creature makes the roll at disadvantage.

trait.name: Psychic Screech
entries: If the Psychatrunk takes fire damage, all creatures within 30 ft. of it must make a {@dc 10} Intelligence saving throw, or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage as the plant lets out a psychic scream of pain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Psychatrunk makes one branch slam attack and one mind slam attack.

action.name: Branch Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mind Slam
entries: The Psychatrunk attempts to strike at the mind of a creature within 60 ft. of it. They must make a {@dc 10} Intelligence saving throw, taking 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage on a failed save.

trait.name: Cursed Aura
entries: If the dragon cursed feral attacks a creature, that creature cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon cursed feral makes up to two attacks between its Death Antlers, Bite and Claws, but each must target a different creature.

action.name: Death Antlers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. The dragon cursed feral can make this attack against a creature only if it moved more than 10 feet in a straight line towards that creature this turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution save or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take an additional 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Gift of the Dracolich {@recharge 6}
entries: The dragon cursed feral exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombear to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the Zombear drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Zombear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage, plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage, plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The elephantom can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Phantom Charge
entries: Creatures the elephantom moves through on its turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) cold damage and fall {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Spectrample
entries: If a creature is {@condition prone}, the elephantom can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage, plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the Tyrannosaurus to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the Tyrannosaurus Hex drops to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Tyrannosaurus Hex has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Tyrannosaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}34 ({@damage 4d12 + 8}) piercing damage. The target must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom save or being {@condition frightened} of the Tyrannosaurus. It can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the target is a medium or smaller creature, it is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the zombie can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage, plus 6 ({@damage 1d12}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The zombie regains hit points at the start of its turn if it hasn't taken radiant damage since its last turn.

trait.name: Spellcasting
entries: The Super Zombie can cast spells, using Constitution as its spellcasting modifier.
The Super Zombie first spawns knowing the cantrip {@spell eldritch blast}, and can add its Constitution modifier to damage rolls dealt by it.
Each subsequent time it spawns, it gains a spell slot that it can use to cast a Warlock spell of a level equal to or below the number of times it has spawned.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} 4 + PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Clobber
entries: {@atk mw} 4 + PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

spell.name: Hyperfocus
entries: Your touch imbues a target with energy, increasing their awareness. They have advantage on dexterity saving throws and initiative rolls, and can't be surprised for the duration of the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot above 2nd.

spell.name: Mark of Vulnerability
entries: You weave a cursed, spectral mark onto a creature you can see within range. Choose a damage type from among Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder.
The target creature loses any resistance to that damage type for the duration of the spell.

spell.name: Wrecking Bolt
entries: You fire a vivid bolt of energy towards an object that isn't being worn or carried or a construct within range, rippling through the structure and targeting any vulnerabilities in its construction.
The target takes {@damage 4d10} force damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Energy Transfer
entries: Choose one creature within range. It gains {@dice 1d8} temporary hit points, and can use its reaction to make a single weapon attack; or cast a spell with a casting time of one action that is of a lower level than the level of this spell; or move up to its movement speed. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the target creature gains an additional {@dice 1d8} temporary hit points for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Moonburst
entries: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} necrotic or radiant damage (your choice) and makes a constitution save. On a failed save, the target is blinded until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Lunar Touch

components.m: A diamond or crystal worth at least 600gp

entries: You imbue a creature with lunar energy, granting it certain benefits that reflect its true nature:

entries.caption: Lunar Touch Benefits
rows: Good
Target gains advantage on all wisdom checks, resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and +2 AC for the duration.
Evil
Target gains {@dice 4d10} temporary hit points, its movement increases by 10 ft, and adds a +2 to its attack rolls for the duration.
Lawful
Target can use an action to glow with a faint, silvery light until they use an action to dismiss the effect.
Chaotic
The target randomly grows or shrinks {@dice 1d6} inches for the duration.
Neutral (if neither Good or Evil)
Target gains advantage on all saving throws against spells and other magical effects for the duration.

spell.name: Rise of the Blood Moon

components.m: Several seeds of any moonseed plant, a vial of the caster's blood, and a spherical, crystal orb worth at least 2,000gp, which the spell consumes

entries: Crimson light shines down in a mile-radius sphere centred at a point you can see within range, penetrating magical darkness and walls and objects less than 12 inches thick. Every humanoid and beast with an intelligence score of 3 or higher illuminated by the crimson light makes a wisdom saving throw (they can choose to fail).

On a failed save they gain immunity to all non-magical, non-silvered weapons; their alignment shifts to match yours; they gain {@dice 5d10} temporary hit points; their base walking speed increases by 10ft; and their AC increases by 1.

If you choose to do so, you can issue a simple command to all those under the effect of the Blood Moon as you cast it. An example could be "Protect the city", "Loot and burn", or "Kill my enemies". Affected creatures will follow the command to the best of their ability, even risking their life, but will not actively harm themselves.
If no command is given, those affected act according to their new alignment for the duration of the spell.
If this spell is cast on the night of a full moon, unwilling creatures make their wisdom saves with disadvantage.
The effect of this spell on an individual can be dispelled with a Dispel Magic spell cast at 9th level.

spell.name: Berserk
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range, that target makes a Charisma saving throw (it can choose to fail), or is affected by this spell. Until the spell ends, the target gains {@dice 1d12} temporary hit points; it gains resistance to bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage; it makes all strength checks, strength saving throws and melee attack rolls with advantage; it deals an additional +2 damage on all melee attacks; attacks against it have advantage; and it cannot concentrate on spells or cast spells.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target gains an additional {@dice 1d12} temporary hit points for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Weave Drain

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 90 feet of you casting a spell

entries: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 6th level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 7th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spells level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.
If the spell fails as a result of you countering it with this spell, you regain a spent spell slot of a level equal to or less than half the level of the spell you countered (rounded down).

spell.name: Spiritual Interposition

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 30 feet of you take damage

entries: You magically intervene in an act of self sacrifice when a creature you can see within range takes damage from an attack. Instead, they take no damage, you take the amount of damage they would have taken, and your hit point total is reduced by the same amount. This damage cannot be resisted or redirected in any way. Your hit point total returns to normal after a short or long rest.

spell.name: Invoke Gobbledegook
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw or else uncontrollably babble incessant, meaningless nonsense. Creatures that speak a language say gobbledegook phrases. Creatures that do not speak a language instead make a constant stream of grunts, howls and whines. While babbling in this way, the target cannot speak anything other than gobbledegook, perform the verbal components of spells, or do anything that requires the articulation of its mouth other than babble.
At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

spell.name: Cascading Impact
entries: Make a ranged spell attack roll at a target within range. On a hit, that creature takes {@damage 3d8} force damage and, if it is Large or smaller, you push it up to 10ft in any direction.
If you push the creature into a space occupied by another creature it stops moving and both creatures take {@damage 1d8} force damage, are pushed 5ft away from each other, and fall prone.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, it deals an extra {@dice 1d8} damage to each creature you damage with this spell for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Episquee
entries: You place a hand on a creature and imbue it with reactive, defensive magic. The next time the target takes damage, as long as they are conscious, they immediately gain temporary hit points equal to twice the damage they took. These hit points last for the duration of the spell, or until the target regains any hit points.

spell.name: Ocular Pat Down
entries: Choose a creature you can see within 60ft. You instantly determine its strength score, dexterity score, and if it is carrying any weapons that aren't concealed by magic.
For the duration of the spell, you also have advantage on any insight checks to detect whether the target is lying, and advantage on any intimidation checks made against the creature.

spell.name: Jelly Legs
entries: A burst of vivid yellow energy engulfs a target creature within range. That creature makes a constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, its equilibrium is thrown off balance. Its walking speed is reduced by 10 feet, it cannot take the dash action, and it has disadvantage on dexterity checks and saving throws until the spell ends.
At the end of each of its turns, the creature can make a constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Mushroom Cloud
entries: A devastating explosion of spores instantly erupts from a point of your choosing within range. Each creature in a 30ft-radius-sphere must make a Constitution saving throw. A target takes {@damage 6d6} poison and {@damage 6d6} acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
The area struck by this effect becomes heavily obscured by thick clouds of dust and spores for as long as the spell lasts.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you can increase the radius of the sphere this spell impacts by 10ft for each level above 6th.

spell.name: Into Shadow
entries: Target creature within range makes a Charisma saving throw (it can choose to fail). On a failed save, it is instantly teleported up to 30ft to an unoccupied space you can see. The chosen space must be on a surface or liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.
When the target is teleported, it takes {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target takes an additional {@dice 1d6} damage for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Price of Empathy

time.condition: which you take when a creature within range takes damage

entries: When a creature you can see within range takes damage, you attempt to form a link between that creature and another, sharing its pain. Choose another creature within range, that target must make a Wisdom saving throw, or take psychic damage equal to half the amount of damage the first creature took.

spell.name: Obsolescence
entries: You invoke the power of shadow to cause a creature's spirit to fade from the living world. When you cast this spell, and at the start of each of your turns, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On every failed save, their movement speed is reduced by 10ft, their AC decreases by 1, and their weapon and spell attacks deal {@dice 1d4} less damage (but no less than 1).
If you concentrate on this spell for the full duration, the target suffers the changes to its stats for the next 7 days.

spell.name: Flaming Binds
entries: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for the duration as they are bound in flaming, spectral chains.

When it fails this saving throw and at the start of each of its turns, the creature takes {@damage 1d8} fire damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level about 3rd.

spell.name: Bide
entries: When you cast this spell, increase your AC by 1.
The first time each round you are hit by an attack, while you are concentrating on this spell, your AC increases by 1.

When this spell ends, you unleash a violent burst of captured kinetic energy at a creature within 30ft of you. That creature takes {@damage 2d8} force damage for each point of AC you gained from this spell's effect while concentrating on it.

spell.name: Precision Bombardment
entries: You let loose a devastating barrage of magical bolts, striking at a creature you can see within range.
Make a ranged spell attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} force damage. This attack scores a critical hit on an 18, 19, or 20.
If you cast Precision Bombardment on your previous turn and scored a critical hit, you can cast it again this turn at the same level without expending a spell slot as a bonus action}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or above, make the attack roll at advantage.

spell.name: Siphon Essence
entries: You become wreathed in purple, spectral flames.

The next time you inflict damage to a creature with a spell or weapon attack, you deal an extra {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage as the flames surrounding you are channeled into the attack. You then gain temporary hit points equal to half the total damage you inflicted.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level about 1st.

spell.name: Six Hundred Needles
entries: When you cast this spell, and as an action on each of your turns, you can weave a cursed needle mark onto a creature you can see within range, which lasts until the spell ends.

After cursing a target in this way, that creature takes {@damage 1d10 + 1} piercing damage for each needle mark you have cursed them with, as spectral needles fly from your outstretched hand and home in on the target.

spell.name: Wall of Slime

components.m: a pinch of powdered snail shell

entries: An opaque wall of dense green slime springs into existence on a solid surface at an unoccupied point you choose in range. You can choose to make this wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 10 feet thick or in a circle that has a 20-foot diameter and is up to 20ft high and 10 feet thick.

A creature can move through the wall, albeit extremely slowly. For every 1 foot the creature moves through the wall, it must spend 10 feet of movement. For as long as a creature is in the wall, it is {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened}, and cannot breathe, speak, or perform the verbal components of spells. It also cannot stand up from being {@condition prone}, take the {@action Dodge} or {@action Dash} action, and has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. A creature has resistance to all damage types except psychic while it is in the wall of slime.
Non-magical weapon attacks cannot pass through the wall, instead getting caught in the slime.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may increase the thickness of the wall by 5ft for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Bubble Prison
entries: You attempt to conjure a bubble of water around a Huge or smaller creature within range. That creature must make a Dexterity saving throw or become encased in a bubble of water. The bubble moves with them as they move.
While in the bubble, they are completely submerged in water. They can't breathe, speak, and have a resistance to all fire damage.

In addition, they have disadvantage on all attack rolls, their movement speed is reduced by 10ft, and the first time each turn they take lightning damage, they take an additional {@damage 1d8} lightning damage.
A creature can use its action to attempt a Dexterity saving throw, escaping the Bubble Prison on a success. When the creature escapes, the bubble breaks and the spell ends.

spell.name: Rainfall
entries: Gentle rain falls in a 120ft radius from a point you choose within range. The water is pure, clean and drinkable.

While concentrating on this spell, you can influence the rainfall, such as limiting the rain to fall only in certain areas, or use an action to create a simple, sensory effect like a rumble of thunder or flash of lightning.
If you concentrate on this spell for the full duration, the rain continues for the next hour before ending.

spell.name: Ranineamorphosis
entries: This spell transforms a creature with at least 1 hit point that you can see within range into a frog or toad. An unwilling creature must make a Constitution saving throw to avoid the effect. A shapechanger automatically succeeds on this saving throw.
The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The target assumes the form of either a {@creature frog} or a {@creature giant toad} (your choice).
Their game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the beast, but they retain their alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma scores.

The target assumes the Hit Points of its new form. When it reverts to its normal form, the creature returns to the number of Hit Points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 Hit Points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 Hit Points, it isn't knocked {@condition unconscious}.

The creature cannot cast spells, speak, or take any action that would be limited by the capabilities of their frog or toad form. Transforming does not break concentration on a spell they have already cast, however, or prevent them from taking actions that are part of a spell, such as {@spell Call Lightning}, that they have already cast.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its Equipment.

spell.name: Blood Bend
entries: You attempt to manipulate the life flow of energy within one Huge or smaller creature you can see within range. If the target has 100 hit points or fewer, you take control of its body until the end of the turn.

While you control a creature in this way, it cannot move in any way that you do not allow. You can use your bonus action} to take total and precise control of the target, during which time you can force the creature to move up to its movement speed and take an action, but you cannot force the creature to cast a spell.
For example, you might force an {@creature adult red dragon} to fly 40 feet, use its breath weapon attack, and then fall {@condition prone}.
And any damage the creature takes while under your control is also dealt to you, as your life force intertwines with its own. At the end of the turn, the creature is freed of your influence.

spell.name: Bloodblade
entries: You evoke a glistening crimson blade of living blood in your hand. Roll a number of hit dice equal to the spell slot level you cast this spell at. Your maximum hit point total is reduced by that many hit points until the spell ends.

The blade lasts until the spell ends. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage for each hit die you rolled to create it, and has the finesse, light, and reach properties.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may use your spellcasting modifier for attack and damage rolls with the blade.

spell.name: Insatiable Fury
entries: You attempt to stir an unquenchable fiery fury in a creature you can see within range. Creatures that can't be {@condition charmed} are immune to this effect.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it instantly takes {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage and flies into an uncontrollable fury. It has advantage on all weapon attacks made against you, but disadvantage on all other attack rolls and ability checks, and has disadvantage on saving throws to maintain concentration for the duration of this spell. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.
A creature can use an action to attempt to overcome its fury, repeating the Wisdom saving throw, ending the effects on a success.

feat.name: Dagger Master
entries: Your mastery of the dagger grants you certain benefits.

items: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, if you make a melee attack with a dagger, you can make one additional melee or ranged attack with a dagger as a part of that action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) per long rest.
When you make an off-hand attack with a dagger as your bonus action, you can add your proficiency bonus to any damage rolled.
If you score a critical hit with a dagger, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage.

feat.name: Whip Master
entries: You have trained many hours with the {@item whip|PHB}, granting you the following benefits:

items: When you make a melee attack with a {@item whip|PHB}, the range of that attack increases to 15ft.
Your damage die for {@item whip|PHB} attacks increases to a d6.

Once per turn, when you hit a large or smaller enemy with a {@item whip|PHB}, you can attempt to pull them off their feet. The target must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) or fall {@condition prone}.

feat.name: Elemental Armourist
entries: When you take this feat select two of the following damage types: Acid, lightning, fire, cold, poison, thunder

Damage you take of the chosen types is reduced by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, you make that saving throw with advantage if the damage type of that effect is one of the types chosen with this feat.
You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Shield Fighting
entries: You have focused your training around the mastery of the {@item shield|PHB}, granting the following benefits:

items: You can benefit from wielding two shields simultaneously (one in each hand) to further increase your AC.
You can use your {@item shield|PHB} as a weapon. It has a range of 5ft and deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.
You can don or doff a {@item shield|PHB} as a bonus action.

feat.name: Superior Shield Fighting
entries: You have invested great effort and training into the mastery of the {@item shield|PHB}, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain an additional +1 to your Armor Class, and your Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saving throws while wielding a {@item shield|PHB} in each hand.
Your melee attacks that use a {@item shield|PHB} now deal {@damage 1d8} + your Strength modifier.

When you score a critical hit when making an attack with a {@item shield|PHB}, your target makes a Constitution saving throw equal to 10 + your Strength modifier. On a failed save, they are {@condition stunned} until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: Cantrip King
entries: You learn an additional three cantrips of your choice from your class's spell list.

items: When you score a critical hit when making an attack roll with a cantrip, add an additional damage die when calculating damage.
At the end of a short rest, you can substitute one cantrip you know with another from your class's spell list.

feat.name: Storm's Wrath
entries: Once per turn, when you make an attack roll, you can switch the damage type of that attack to lightning damage.

Once per turn, when you score a critical hit with an attack that deals lightning damage to a creature, that creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: After Image
entries: When you take the {@action Dash} action, an illusory duplicate of you appears in your space. It lasts for one minute or until destroyed. The duplicate moves with you and mimics your actions, shifting position and making it impossible to tell which one is real. Your duplicate has an AC equal to 10 + your Dexterity modifier.

Each time a creature targets you for an attack, roll a {@dice d20} to see if it hits you or your duplicate. With a roll of 11 or above, the attack targets your After Image. Your duplicate is destroyed only by an attack that hits it. It ignores all other damage and effects.
An attacking creature is unaffected by this ability if it can't see, or if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight.
Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you take a long rest.

feat.name: Big Pecks
entries: While you are unarmored and not carrying a shield, your AC increases by 1. In addition, you may roll for {@skill Persuasion} and {@skill Intimidation} skill checks using your Strength modifier, rather than your Charisma modifier.

feat.name: Ingenious Trickster
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Deception} and {@skill Performance} skills. In addition, you learn the spell {@spell suggestion} and one cantrip from the enchantment school of magic. You can cast {@spell suggestion} without expending a spell slot. Once cast in this way, you can't cast it using this trait again until you finish a long rest.
Spellcasters may use their normal spellcasting modifier and spell save DC for these spells.
For non-spellcasters, your spellcasting modifier for these spells is Charisma, and your save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

feat.name: Quick Draw
entries: If you drew a weapon this turn, you can make your first melee weapon attack with that weapon with advantage. This attack crits on an 18, 19, or 20, and your reach for this attack is increased by 5 feet. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short rest or long rest, or until you next roll for initiative.

feat.name: You're Already Dead
entries: When you make a melee weapon attack against a surprised enemy, you score a critical hit on an 18, 19, or 20.
In addition, whenever you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack against an enemy, they take force damage equal to your level at the start of their next turn.

feat.name: Finesse Fighting Master
entries: You have mastered the art of elegant and dexterous fighting while using {@itemProperty F||finesse} weapons.

Whenever you make an attack with a {@itemProperty F||finesse} weapon on your turn, you can take a -5 penalty on your attack roll. If you hit, you gain +5 AC until the start of your next turn. You can benefit from this AC boost only once per round.
In addition, if you score a critical hit with a melee {@itemProperty F||finesse} weapon attack, you can forgo rolling the extra damage dice to {@action Dodge} instead.

feat.name: Swift Striker
entries: Whenever you would roll for initiative, as long as you are not surprised, you can choose to make a single ranged weapon attack or melee weapon attack immediately before making your roll. If you do so, make your initiative roll with disadvantage.

feat.name: Spell Sprinter
entries: You have mastered the art of sustaining a magical bombardment whilst manoeuvring yourself in the heat of battle.
On your turn, if you take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Dash} action, you can cast a cantrip using your bonus action.

feat.name: Sparring Partner
entries: While you are within 10ft of an allied player character with the Sparring Partner feat who isn't {@condition incapacitated}, increase your attack rolls, saving throws, and armour class by 1.

feat.name: Choke Out
entries: You have trained fiercely in the art of grapple fighting, maximising the impact of your pins and choke holds.
While you are grappling a creature, you can use your bonus action to crush it.
At the end of the crushed creature's next turn, if it is still {@condition grappled} by you, it gains a point of {@condition exhaustion}.
If the grappled creature breaks free, it loses one point of {@condition exhaustion} that it has accrued from this effect at the end of each of its turns that it isn't {@condition grappled}.

feat.name: Advanced Sparring Tactics
entries: While you are within 10ft of an allied player character with the Advanced Sparring Tactics feat who isn't {@condition incapacitated}, make all melee attack rolls at advantage, and no creature can make a melee attack roll with advantage against you.

feat.name: Unpredictable Enhancement
entries: You embrace a chaotic burst of magical power, enhancing yourself in unpredictable ways.

items: Increase a randomly determined ability score by 2, and decrease a randomly determined ability score by 1.
You gain proficiency in a randomly determined saving throw that you don't already have proficiency in.
Whenever you roll a natural 1 on a saving throw or skill check that you are proficient in, you can reroll that saving throw or skill check. You must use the new roll.

feat.name: Worldly
entries: Across a life of adventuring you have seen many incredible things and met many people, learning and growing from new experiences and cultures all the while.

items: Choose a background. You gain all skill proficiencies and other bonuses associated with that background, in addition to your current one.

feat.name: Light Armour Master
entries: You have trained extensively with Light Armour, learning to maximize the benefits it offers.
While you are wearing light armour, you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your AC by 1.

Whenever you make a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that you can see, such as a trap or a spell, you may roll {@dice 1d6} and add that number to the roll. To gain this benefit, you can't be {@condition incapacitated}. You can use this ability a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency modifier.

feat.name: Colossal Strength
entries: Increase your Strength-based attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks by 1.
When you make a Strength saving throw, you can choose to make that save at advantage. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

feat.name: Inner Courage
entries: You learn the {@spell heroism} spell and you can cast it without using a spell slot. You may cast it at a level equal to your proficiency bonus or below. Once you cast it in this way, you cannot do so again until you finish a short rest.
You can also cast the spell with any spell slots you have. The stat you increased with this feat is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

feat.name: Mesmeriser
entries: You learn one 1st level spell from the enchantment school of magic and you can cast it at its lowest level without using a spell slot. Once you cast it in this way, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you take this feat).

Whenever you cast a spell or use an ability that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist the {@condition charmed} condition, roll {@dice 2d4} and subtract that number from the creature's roll. Once you use this trait, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Unassailable
entries: Increase your Dexterity-based attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks by 1.
When you make a Dexterity saving throw, you can choose to make that save at advantage. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Fighting Spirit
entries: You gain a number of Ki Points equal to your Wisdom modifier. These ki points are added to your existing pool, and recharge after a short rest.

feat.name: Practiced Grappler
entries: You have advantage on {@skill Athletics} checks made to grapple another creature, and creatures have disadvantage on checks made to escape your grapple.
While you are grappling a creature, you can make a single weapon attack against that creature as a bonus action.

feat.name: Professional Coward
entries: Your movement speed increases by 10ft.

As long as you don't cast a spell or take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can take the {@action Dash} or {@action Dodge} action as a bonus action, and your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

feat.name: Cunning Intellect
entries: Increase your Intelligence-based attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks by 1.
When you make an Intelligence saving throw, you can choose to make that save at advantage. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Pledge of Intervention
entries: When you roll initiative, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
In addition, you gain one Divine Favour from a powerful, celestial being.

Once, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, you are instead teleported to a safe, familiar location on the material plane. You instantly gain the full benefits of a long rest, and then gain points of {@condition exhaustion} until you have five.
Once this favour has been called upon, you cannot use it again.

feat.name: Stalwart
entries: Your body has grown remarkably tough and unyielding.
Whenever a creature scores a critical hit against you, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to one damage type of that attack until the end of this turn.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws to resist or end the {@condition poisoned} condition.

feat.name: Acrobat
entries: You gain proficiency in {@skill Performance} and {@skill Acrobatics}. If you already have proficiency in any of those skills, you gain expertise in that skill instead, doubling your proficiency bonus for any ability check you make with it.
In addition, you learn the {@spell jump} spell, and can cast it with any spell slots you have.

You can also cast {@spell jump} without any components, targeting yourself, as a bonus action, without using a spell slot. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Cursed Form
entries: As a bonus action, you can take on a terrifying, monstrous form. It may be that bestial fur sprouts over your body, your teeth grow to form large fangs, your eyes turn jet black, your skin turns milky white, or some other physical transformation. This transformation is visual only, has no impact on your abilities, and lasts for one minute, or until you fall {@condition unconscious}.
While in your Monstrous Form, you gain the following benefits.

items: You gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus at the start of each of your turns. When the transformation ends, you lose any temporary hit points gained from this effect.
You have advantage on {@skill Intimidation} checks.
You resist necrotic, cold or poison damage (choose when you transform).
The first attack you make each turn deals an additional {@damage 1d8} necrotic, cold or poison damage (the same damage type as your resistance) on a hit.

entries: Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Levitation
entries: As a bonus action, you can grant yourself a fly speed of 10ft and you can hover. These effects last for the next minute, after which time you float gently to the ground if you are still aloft.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

feat.name: Glimpse of Infinity
entries: You learn the {@spell guidance} cantrip, and gain proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} and {@skill History} skills.
In addition, you can read all writing and understand any spoken language, but you cannot speak languages you do not know.

item.name: Essence Capture Vessel
entries: Made from simple wood and bearing only a basic runic inscription, the Essence Capture Vessel does not appear outwardly powerful. A creature who puts an ear to the locket can hear a gentle swirling sound.

As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet of you dies, you can make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check with a DC equal to that creature's CR or level + 5. On a success, a fragment of the creature's essence is bound to the Essence Capture Vessel.
The Vessel can only house one creature's essence at a time, and cannot be opened while housing a creature's essence.
The bound creature cannot be restored to life by any means shorter than a {@spell wish} spell.

In addition, while attuned, the Essence Capture Vessel grants you one Special Trait or damage resistance of the captured creature, at the DM's discretion. For example, the captured essence may grant you a hezrou's Magic Resistance, a white dragon's Ice Walk, a giant hyena's Rampage, or a water elemental's resistance to acid damage.

As an action, you can release the fragment of essence stored within the Essence Capture Vessel, at which point it loses all abilities associated with the captured creature and cannot be used to seal another essence for {@dice 1d8} days.

item.name: Countercharm Locket
entries: This tiny locket has the symbol of an open palm etched on the surface, and holds a small mirror inside.
If you fail a saving throw against either the {@condition frightened} or {@condition charmed} condition, you instead succeed, and the Countercharm Locket crumbles to dust.

item.name: Jack's Magical Music Box
entries: This tiny music box plays a delicate and sorrowful tune when open and echoes out in a 30-foot radius. The music plays for 10 minutes, after which the box automatically closes and cannot be reopened until the next dawn.

A creature within 30 feet of the open box can understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when it speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

Creatures within range of the open box have advantage on any ability check to interact socially with any creature also within range that isn't immune to the {@condition charmed} condition or {@condition deafened}.

Up to one creature can choose to concentrate on the box for the full 10 minute duration of the music. If it does so, it gains the benefits of a short rest. It cannot benefit from this effect of Jack's Magical Music Box again for {@dice 1d4} days.

item.name: Vibranite Shield
entries: While holding this shield, when you take the Attack action, you can use one of your attacks to hurl the shield at a creature within 60 feet. Make a ranged attack roll against that target using either Strength or Dexterity. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked {@condition prone}.

On a critical hit, the shield ricochets off the creature it strikes and towards another creature within 30 feet of your choice. Make a new ranged attack roll against the new target, treating all rolls and damage as a part of the same Attack action.
As a bonus action, if you have at least one hand free and the shield is within 90 feet of you, you can speak a command word to cause the Vibranite Shield to animate and fly into your empty hand.

item.name: Moonblessed Shield
entries: As a reaction, if an enemy hits you with a melee attack, you can activate the Moonblessed Shield to let loose a burst of blinding, radiant light. All creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 10 + your proficiency bonus) or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn.
Once you use this property of the Moonblessed Shield, you cannot do so again until the next dawn.

item.name: Familiar's Brooch
entries: This magical brooch strengthens the bond between a familiar and their summoner. While both of you are attuned to the brooch, you gain the following benefits:

items: You can see through your familiar's eyes and hear what it hears as a bonus action, rather than an action.
You can communicate telepathically with your familiar across a number of miles equal to your proficiency bonus.
When you cast a spell that targets only you, you can choose to target your familiar as well.

If within 5 feet of both you and a hostile enemy, your familiar can use its reaction to feint or otherwise distract your foe, giving them disadvantage on their next melee attack roll made against you.

item.name: Fated Coin (Heads)
entries: This silver coin bears the head of a dragon on both sides. As an action, you can roll it across your fingers to cast the spell {@spell longstrider} at 3rd level. Once used in this way, the Fated Coin (Heads) cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Fated Coin (Tails)
entries: This silver coin bears the tail of a dragon on both sides. As an action, you can roll it across your fingers to cast the spell {@spell pass without trace}. Once used in this way, the Fated Coin (Tails) cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Fey Longbow
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to damage and attack rolls made with this weapon.

This bow has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 - 1} charges each dawn. As a bonus action, you can infuse an arrow with the Fey Longbow's energy. Until the end of this turn, if you shoot that arrow from the Fey Longbow to a point within the weapon's normal range, a willing creature within 10 feet of you can use its reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of where the arrow landed.

item.name: Eldritch Chaos Hat
entries: This tattered, frayed hat whispers dark promises of power to its wearer.
When you make a ranged spell attack that targets only one creature, the Eldritch Chaos Hat sends a flood of eldritch energy through you, granting the following effects:

items: You gain a +1 to your spell attack roll.
The spell deals an additional {@damage 2d8} force damage on a hit.
If the spell misses, the Eldritch Chaos Hat deals {@damage 1d8} force damage to you. Damage dealt to you by the Eldritch Chaos Hat can't be prevented or reduced in any way.

item.name: Chaos Boots
entries: While you wear these boots, you can use a bonus action and click the boots' heels together. If you do, the boots impart the following effects:

items: Your walking speed increases by 20 feet.
You can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down, while leaving your hands free.
You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

Your body shimmers with pale blue light, emits a gentle humming sound, and releases a faint scent of burning. You make Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks with disadvantage and gain no benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

entries: If you click your heels together again, you end these effects. When the boots' property has been used for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Chaos Shield
entries: You gain an additional +1 bonus to AC while wielding this shield.
Whenever a melee attack aimed at you misses by 3 or less, the Chaos Shield blasts the attacker with a burst of force. They take force damage equal to half your AC, rounded down.

Whenever an enemy scores a critical hit against you with a melee weapon attack, the Chaos Shield vanishes into the Ethereal Plane, and you lose any benefit from wielding it. It reappears on the ground in front of you {@dice 1d10} minutes after disappearing.

item.name: Funny Bone
entries: A seemingly innocuous human radius bone.

As an action, you can use the Funny Bone to cast the spell {@spell tasha's hideous laughter||hideous laughter}, replacing the spell's material components with the Funny Bone. Once you use this feature of the Funny Bone, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.
At the DM's discretion, the bone may also speak jokes aloud periodically.

item.name: Gambler's Boots
entries: While you wear these boots, you can use your bonus action to click the heels together once, twice, or three times to activate them for 10 minutes or until you use a bonus action to end the effect.
For each time you clicked your heels, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and your armor class decreases by 1.
When the boots' property has been used for 60 minutes, the magic ceases to function until the next dawn.

item.name: Saddle of the Zoologist
entries: This simple leather saddle will shift in size and dimensions to accommodate any form or shape. While a creature is willingly wearing the saddle, it can be mounted by any other creature of size equal to or smaller than its own, regardless of whether their anatomy is appropriate.
In addition, a creature wearing the saddle increases their base walking, swimming, climbing, and flying speeds by 10 feet while mounted (if they have them).

item.name: Bag of Colding
entries: This bag functions as a normal {@item bag of holding}, with the following benefits:

items: Organic matter stored in the Bag of Colding is preserved perfectly. A corpse placed in the Bag of Colding is treated as being dead for only as long as the amount of time it has spent outside of the Bag of Colding.
You can withdraw a 5-foot cube of ice from the Bag of Colding each day. This ice does not count against the carrying capacity of the Bag of Colding.

As an action, you can open the Bag of Colding, aim it at a target, and speak a command word. A blast of freezing wind shoots from the bag in a 30-foot-long line. Any creature in this line must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Once you use this feature, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Hat of all Fashions
entries: While attuned to this hat, you can attempt to read and activate spell scrolls from any spellcasting class, not just your own. When you do so, make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check (DC = 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell takes effect.

item.name: The Bard's Boom Box
entries: This simple music box has a dial that can be turned from numbers 0–11.
If the dial is set to 0, no music can be heard.
If the dial is turned to 1, an incredibly faint melody emanates from the box.
As the dial is turned higher, the volume increases. At 10, the music is deafeningly loud.

If the dial is turned to 11, the music instantly stops, and the Bard's Boom Box explodes one round later. All creatures within 15 feet of the Boom Box when it explodes must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 12d6} thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

item.name: Bijou of the Banshee
entries: A beautiful, ornately fashioned jewel, housing the magical essence of a banshee.
As an action, you can throw the jewel up to 60 feet, whereupon it shatters on contact with the ground or an object or creature.

From the point where the Bijou shatters, a mournful wail is released. This wail has no effect on constructs and undead. All other creatures within 30 feet that can hear the wail must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

item.name: Bijou of the Sphinx
entries: A beautiful, ornately fashioned jewel, housing the magical essence of a sphinx.

As an action, you can throw the jewel up to 60 feet, whereupon it shatters on contact with the ground or an object or creature. When you hurl this Bijou, choose a number of creatures you can see equal to your proficiency modifier. Those creatures are immune to its effects.

From the point where the Bijou shatters, a deafening roar is released. All other creatures within 100 feet that can hear the roar must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10|8d10}) thunder damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

item.name: Bijou of the Gold Dragon
entries: A beautiful, ornately fashioned jewel, housing the magical essence of a gold dragon.
As an action, you can throw the jewel up to 60 feet, whereupon it shatters on contact with the ground or an object or creature.

From the point where the Bijou shatters, a translucent, white gas is released in a 30-foot-radius sphere. All other creatures in that area must make a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature has disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

item.name: Bijou of the Hezrou
entries: A beautiful, ornately fashioned jewel, housing the magical essence of a hezrou.
As an action, you can throw the jewel up to 60 feet, whereupon it shatters on contact with the ground or an object or creature.

From the point where the Bijou shatters, a translucent, green gas is released in a 30-foot-radius sphere. All other creatures in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

item.name: Bloodwell Claws
entries: These black, fingerless gloves are patterned with a sprawling, crimson, jagged design.
As a bonus action, you can activate the Bloodwell Claws for 1 minute. The gloves grow to form vicious, long claws, granting you the following benefits:

items: Your AC increases by 2.
You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks.
Any sorcerer cantrips with the ranged property also become melee spell attacks with a range of 15 feet.
When you strike a creature with a melee weapon cantrip, you can add your Charisma modifier to any damage you roll.

entries: Once the Bloodwell Claws have been activated, they cannot be used again until the following dawn.

item.name: Cursed Vial
entries: Any liquid stored in this vial is imbued with foul, necrotic magic. This cursed liquid is indistinguishable from its normal form. Once the Cursed Vial corrupts a liquid in this way, it cannot do so again until the next dawn.

Any creature who ingests the cursed liquid becomes {@condition poisoned} and takes {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns until the curse is lifted by {@spell remove curse} or other similar magic.

You can also use an action to apply the cursed liquid to any piercing weapon, though when you hit a target with an attack the curse reacts differently. That target must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, or take {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage and become {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Scroll of Kraken's Favour
entries: Using an action to read this scroll causes it to disintegrate as a magical tear in the fabric of space appears at a point you choose within 30 feet. The portal is one way only; you can choose to create it as an entrance or exit to your current location when you use the scroll.

entries.name: Entrance
entries: Three gargantuan tentacles emerge through the gateway, and each immediately strikes out at creatures you designate within 30 feet of the portal's opening. Make an attack roll for each tentacle: {@h} 17 to hit, dealing {@damage 3d6 + 10} bludgeoning damage each.

On a hit, if the target is a Large or smaller creature and that tentacle isn't already grappling a creature, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is also {@condition restrained}.
You can use an action on each of your turns to command three attacks with the tentacles. The portal closes after {@dice 1d4 - 1} rounds, and the tentacles vanish.

entries.name: Exit
entries: You, and any number of creatures within 30 feet that you designate when you use this scroll, can pass through the gateway and emerge at a random, safe location on the Material Plane. When a creature passes through the portal in this way, they gain temporary hit points equal to their level multiplied by their Constitution modifier.
If a creature you didn't designate attempts to pass through the portal, they take {@damage 4d10} lightning damage and fall {@condition prone}.
The portal closes after {@dice 1d4 - 1} rounds.

item.name: Cantrip Cube
entries: This small, magical box contains one random stored cantrip from the following list:

items: {@spell dancing lights}
{@spell druidcraft}
{@spell light}
{@spell minor illusion}
{@spell mold earth}
{@spell Rainfall|DMSecretWeapon}
{@spell prestidigitation}
{@spell thaumaturgy}

entries: Any creature can use a bonus action to activate one effect the held cantrip can produce, or you can set the box to repeat one effect the held cantrip can produce automatically every minute, until you use an action while holding the box to end this effect. If a spell requires concentration, it lasts for 1 minute.
If the box would force a creature to make a saving throw, the DC for that saving throw is 13.

item.name: Pumpkinhead Cowl
entries: While wearing this cowl, your AC increases by 1, you become immune to the {@condition frightened} condition, and you can see in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.
In addition, while wearing the cowl, you can cast the spell {@spell phantom steed} as a ritual once per dawn, except the duration of the spell increases to 8 hours.

Finally, while wearing the cowl, you can use an action to remove your head from your shoulders and hold it. In this form, you continue to see through your head and can control your body as normal. Your head cannot move on its own, shares your body's AC, has 13 hit points, and remains conscious while your body takes a long rest or is knocked {@condition unconscious}.

If you cast a spell that targets yourself, it targets both your head and your body, even if they are apart. If a spell or ability would change the form of your body, only your body changes, and your head remains the same within the Pumpkinhead Cowl.
If your head is destroyed while separated from your form in the Pumpkinhead Cowl, only the cowl is destroyed, and your head instantly, magically reforms on your body.
You can reattach your head to your form by using an action to hold it to your neck.

item.name: Pendant of Life & Death
entries: This glistening pendant shifts in colour, reflecting how close its wielder strays to the land of the dead. It has 4 charges, and regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges each dawn.

As a bonus action while wearing this pendant, you can expend 1 charge to grant another creature within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. You can use this ability only if your remaining hit points are over half that of your hit point total.

As a bonus action while wearing this pendant, you can expend 1 charge to curse another creature within 60 feet. That creature takes {@damage 1d8} + your Constitution modifier necrotic damage. You can use this ability only if your remaining hit points are below half that of your hit point total.
As a bonus action, if you made an attack with the Blade of Allies this turn, you can activate it to create a glowing aura that extends in a 10-foot radius from you until the start of your next turn.

Allies that start their turn within the aura gain a +2 to their attack rolls, damage rolls and death saving throws until the end of their turn. In addition, if an ally within that aura would take damage, you can use your reaction to halve that damage.
You gain a +1 to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
You cannot cast spells or attack with any other weapon while wielding an activated Chaos Rapier.

As a bonus action while attuned to the Chaos Rapier, you can speak its command word to activate it for the next 10 minutes. Roll a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 10 or less you gain the following benefits:

items: Attack rolls against you have disadvantage.
You can use your reaction to parry when hit by an attack to gain +3 AC, potentially turning a hit into a miss.
You move 10 ft. in a random direction at the end of your turn.

entries: On an 11 or above you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on all attack rolls.
You can use your reaction to instantly make a melee weapon attack whenever an enemy moves within 5 ft. of you, or makes an attack against any other target while within 5 ft. of you.
You gain 10 temporary hit points or lose 10 hit points at the end of each of your turns, at random.

entries: Attuning to Gumdack's Magic "Wand" grants you proficiency with firearms.
This curious magic "wand" is hewn from metal. It can be held in one hand, and can be loaded with any tiny, non-magical object (such as a pebble) as a bonus action.

As an action on your turn, you can make a ranged weapon attack with the wand against a creature within 90 ft., adding your spellcasting modifier to attack and damage rolls, as the "wand" magically hurls its ammunition.
On a hit, the creature takes a Xd4 bludgeoning damage, where X is equal to your proficiency modifier.

When Gumdack's Magic "Wand" is fired, it lets loose a loud bang and billows out a cloud of black smoke. The area in a 5-foot radius of the wand becomes heavily obscured by smoke until the start of your next turn.
While wielding this sword, you gain a +1 to your AC.

In addition, you can use your reaction to parry a blow, giving you a bonus to your AC equal to your proficiency modifier against that one attack. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

When a weapon attack made with this blade kills a creature with an Intelligence score of 7 or higher, this weapon gains a +1 to all attack and damage rolls until the next dawn. This blade can benefit from this feature up to three times per dawn, for a maximum of +3 to attack and damage rolls.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This weapon is cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. Until the curse is broken with a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic, you are unwilling to take prisoners or show mercy to defeated enemies.

table.name: Non-Combat Encounter Plot Hooks
intro: Here's a list of plot hooks for Non-Combat Encounters. They make for a refreshing change of pace from typical combat encounters. Feel free to roll randomly to quickly create some varied encounters for your next session/one-shot, or pick the ones you like best.
rows: A prize winning truffle {@creature owlbear} has escaped! Chase it through the city while minimising the damage caused and catch it unharmed.
A local gang wants to demonstrate their ownership of their territory. Sneak through and tag the area with graffiti while avoiding the notice of the guards and locals.
A ship at sail faces an oncoming storm. Man the sails, batten down the hatches, steer the vessel, and hold on for dear life.
A team of 5 belligerent, indestructible Golems stand in the party's way. Any time a PC tries to move around one, it moves to block their path.
The party is challenged to a fishing contest. Honour is at stake, and the local fish are huge. Catch as many as you can by any means necessary!
The party is conscripted at the last moment to prepare a meal for a royal dignitary. Find suitable ingredients and cook something up.
The party must sneak into a noble's mansion and steal incriminating etchings.
It's a Battle of the Bards, and everyone needs to play. The party put on a musical show to the best of their ability.
The bridge across a ravine has fallen! Find another way across. You're athletic enough to swing on those hanging vines, right?
A young noble has become dangerously addicted to {@item potion of speed||Potions of Speed}. Snap him out of it, but you'll need to catch him first.
The ruined building the party is in has started to collapse, dodge the falling rubble and keep on your feet as you flee before rocks fall and everybody dies.
A noble hires the party to sabotage his rival's date. Make sure it does not go well, but be subtle about it.
A cave-in traps the party below ground, turning the way out into a labyrinthine maze and obstacle course to escape through the rubble.
A warforged is terribly injured. Find their missing parts and correctly repair them before they completely fall apart.
A gambling ring is in town! Lie, bluff, cheat, steal, and pull any trick you can to earn a killing before the town guard bust the operation.
The party is tasked with looking after some poorly trained and excitable pet {@creature dire wolf||Dire Wolves}.
The only way across the chasm is on the back of a {@creature hippogriff}, if you can catch one, tame it, and manage to hang on that is.
Prison escape! You have no weapons, no armour, and no chance of winning a fight against the guard. Time to get sneaky on ‘em.
The local tavern is in need of entertainment for the night. Put on a show with whatever skills you can muster, be they magic, muscle or music. Just make it entertaining.
A chromatic dragon wyrmling is terrorising livestock. Find a way to get it to leave without drawing the fury of its parents upon the village.

table.name: Tavern Names
intro: Is there anything quite like a tavern in Dungeons and Dragons? Usually one of the first places a party will seek out, having a tavern name on hand is crucial in building a believable world. A few back up names are handy too, for when your party inevitably runs into trouble in the first tavern and needs to vacate to another watering hole in the city. Roll randomly on this somewhat punny table or choose the most suitable for your campaign setting to create a name for your tavern.

table.name: Quick Quest Concepts: Table 1
intro: These are plot hooks or quest ideas designed to stimulate your own creative process. Roll randomly or choose ideas that inspire you to generate quick ideas for sidequests, one shots, or quest complications and diversions.
rows: A farmer needs someone to find the cause of her missing livestock.
An emergency substitute teacher is needed for the local school.
The mayor has been gambling with gold meant for the town's upkeep, and someone needs to snap them out of it before word gets around.
A bootlegging gang has started a racket selling faulty magical potions, to disastrous (and hilarious) effects.
All of the animals in town have started talking.
A well known Noble has been spotted disguised in rags, begging for gold in the streets.
A valuable painting has been stolen from a local Noble's mansion.
A powerful bard has been cursing people to speak only in rhyme.
A novice necromancer has accidentally animated all the carcasses at a local butchers, which are now running wild.
A vile disease has swept the city, but it only seems to be affecting the wealthy.
It is raining, but only where the party is. 10ft beyond where they stand it is a beautiful day.
The sewers have been overrun with strange creatures. Go in and eliminate them!
An immortal chicken is making a scene downtown. No matter what the guards do, their weapons seemingly do it no harm.
A powerful neighbouring nation has sent a diplomat to visit this city, and they require protection.
A cat is stuck up in a {@creature treant}.
A local gang of thieves require a huge public distraction to carry out a heist on a noble's home.
A young man has gone missing, leaving a note of farewell his mother insists is not in his handwriting.
The party's magical weapons have their magic properties stolen by a fey spirit who challenges the PCs to a game of riddles in order to win them back.
A noble has been walking his pet {@creature owlbear} through the city, terrifying the locals and town guards.
A local tavern is hosting an illegal, late night fighting pit tournament throughout the week.
Demonic cultists have moved into the city, and started gathering new followers from among the locals.
An overzealous Guard Captain has locked up some friends of the party.
A party member is accused of a crime, with multiple witnesses insisting they saw them do it.

The party are called to investigate the murder trial of a pair of young lovers who have gone missing from their beds. The accused is a local merchant who insists his innocence, despite his wares having been found at the scene.
The mayor has been turned into a {@creature giant toad}, and needs a remedy before word gets out and his position is compromised.

table.name: Undesirables: Table of Names

Having a name on hand is one of the most important elements of worldbuilding, as without having one for a newly introduced NPC, the illusion of a tangible reality all DMs aim to build quickly falls apart.

For this reason, you may find it a powerful storytelling tool to select noble names from this list, which leans toward more "human" naming conventions, for all NPC nobles, regardless of their race, because it will instantly communicate a sense of nobility for your players to understand.
